summary: Saving a Berquist Sherman method no longer waits about 15 seconds after its dependent updates have already finished.
details: Dataset sidecar saves now run their dependent walk on ArcRho Engine like every other method save, instead of queueing a job the client had to poll for.
The poll read the job status over the network share, where Windows caches the file for up to 10 seconds and hid a result that was already written.
